title: Sketching Word Vectors on the 2D Plane
hints: Use the Arrow tool to draw the coordinate axes.
Use Yellow or Cyan chalk for the word vectors.
Click Show Solution to compare with the reference diagram.

drawing.prompt_text: Sketch the 2D plane with King [0.9, 0.1] and Queen [0.8, 0.3], showing angle theta.
drawing.solution_explanation: Both King and Queen vectors point in almost the same direction in the first quadrant, forming an acute angle theta (~10 degrees) that results in a high cosine similarity (>0.95).
